name: live-v13-refusal
objective: v2.3 replan V13 (and plan 07's missing refusal fixture, L4), with the real model reading every turn: the prepared route asks the player to accept a duel, the player refuses twice and negotiates. The refused-route card must appear only after real reads covered both turns and moved no exit; it must state only what the code knows, offer the authored alternate, and offer no 'Generate the road ahead' on an authored exit. Control: a turn that accepts the duel moves the exit, the story transitions, and the card is gone.

steps.eval: const sel = "[data-so=\"agency-take-alternate\"]"; const end = Date.now() + 15000; let last = null; let stable = 0; let scrolls = 0; while (Date.now() < end) { const el = document.querySelector(sel); if (el) { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const inView = r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 && r.top >= 0 && r.left >= 0 && r.bottom <= window.innerHeight && r.right <= window.innerWidth; if (!inView) { el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); scrolls += 1; stable = 0; last = null; } else { const pos = `${Math.round(r.top)}:${Math.round(r.left)}`; stable = pos === last ? stable + 1 : 0; last = pos; if (stable >= 2) return { inView: true, top: Math.round(r.top), viewport: window.innerHeight, scrolls }; } } await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250)); } const el = document.querySelector(sel); const r = el?.getBoundingClientRect(); throw new Error(`could not scroll ${sel} into view and hold it there (as a user would before clicking): ${JSON.stringify(el ? { top: Math.round(r.top), bottom: Math.round(r.bottom), viewport: window.innerHeight, scrolls } : 'missing')}`);
